summary.text: Lloyd Larsen is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 54, serving since January 2013, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lloyd Larsen assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 7, 2013, succeeding Del McOmie.
For 2025-2026, Larsen is co-chair of the Riverton State Office Task Force and serves on the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee.
